title: C#, ASP.NET Developer
description:
We are seeking ASP.NET developers responsible for building Cloud based CRM, Taxation and Business Accounting software using ASP.Net, jQuery/Vue.JS \& SQL Server. Your primary responsibility will be to design and develop our applications, and to coordinate with the rest of the team working on different layers of the infrastructure. A commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and quality product is essential.

  



Required candidate for .Net skills with minimum experience of 3\-6 years.


**Technical Skills*** ASP.Net, .Net Framework 3\.5 or above, C\#, SQL Server 2008 and above
* HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, Responsive Web Design
* Visual Studio 2010 or above
* Knowledge of HTML5, Mobile Development is an advantage
* Experience with either Web Services or WCF
* Experience writing applications using AJAX is a must
* Experience in cross browser compatibility
* Experience with UI debugging and profiling tools
* Experience with SQL Server including SQL and stored procedures
* Experience performance tuning web applications
* Experience using source control and bug tracking systems in a team environment

**Roles \& Responsibilities*** Design and develop architecture and frameworks for products using ASP.NET, C\#, WCF, WF, JavaScript technologies and SQL Server
* Provide architecture guidance to the project team working on products with strong focus on solution architecture, architecture artifacts,
* performance, scaling and security
* Lead architecture aspects of software development with strong emphasis on Object Oriented analysis and design (OOAD), layered application
* development, domain driven design, architecture design patterns
* Should be completely hands on in coding
* Practice standard development process leveraging agile methodologies such as SCRUM and Test Drive Development
* Knowledge of jQuery is a must
* Providing Technology Direction/Guidance to project teams
* Acts as a single point of contact to facilitate resolution of technical issues and escalation by working closely with Quality Assurance department
* Customize existing automation framework and build reusable libraries
* Build and deploy centralized Knowledge Management Framework for the engagement
* Assists in the training/mentoring of team members, including testers, developers, and business analysts
* Excellent communication and presentation skills

**Pre\-requisites*** Candidate should be B.Sc./M.sc./B.E./B.Tech./ MCA with good communication and positive attitude
* Experience in Agile development will be an added advantage
* Typically requires 3\-6 years relevant experience

Interested candidates please send your updated resume with following details to career@relate\-infotech.com.


Salary: INR 5,00,000 – 8,50,000 PA. Salary will not be a bar for right candidate.

title: DATA MANAGEMENT EXECUTIVE / ERP DEVELOPER EXECUTIVE
description:
Job description:

We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented ERP Executive / ERP Developer to manage, maintain, and develop our ERP system while ensuring strong MIS reporting and data management capabilities. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with process flow management, flowcharts, and various management systems such as FMS, IMS, and MIS.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and maintain the organization's ERP system, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day functioning.
* Develop, customize, and enhance ERP modules as per business requirements.
* Design, prepare, and maintain process flowcharts for different business operations.
* Handle process flow management to streamline operational processes across departments.
* Collect, organize, and maintain accurate data across departments and systems.
* Ensure data integrity, cleanliness, and consistency in the ERP system and related databases.
* Prepare, update, and maintain MIS reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of all MIS reports to the management team.
* Coordinate with different departments to gather data and validate records in the ERP system.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of sensitive company data.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Proven experience in ERP system management and/or ERP development.
* Strong knowledge of data management practices and MIS reporting.
* Proficiency in creating process flowcharts (Google Sheets/docs, flowchart tools or similar.
* Working knowledge of FMS, IMS, and MIS systems.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Dashboards, etc.)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and ensure timely report submission.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

* Provident Fund
